item.title: Version 1.5.70
item.description:
🎉 v1.5.70 Update

  • ✨ Use OnText Without Selecting Text
    - Choose Clipboard First in General settings.
    - Open the panel with your copied content when no text is selected.
  • ✨ Run Inline AI Presets from Actions
    - Run a saved Inline AI prompt directly from the action panel, and create these actions with Create with AI.
  • 🚀 Faster, More Reliable Input
    - Improved panel focus and cursor-word capture, with fixes for Chrome, Safari, Word, VS Code, Notion, Obsidian, Preview, and Warp.
  • 🔧 Smoother Action Attachments
    - The action picker focuses Search actions as soon as it opens and closes automatically after attaching an action.
